description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'TestlinkXMLRPCServerTest' that performs unit tests on the Testlink XML-RPC API, including testing report submission, project retrieval, test case lookups, and permission checks.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that contains multiple test methods for verifying the functionality and correctness of the Testlink XML-RPC API functions, including authentication, report submission, retrieval of projects, test plans, test cases, and permission checks.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test client and sets debug mode before each test run.

methods.description: Defines specific test cases to run in the test suite, facilitating selective testing.
